cards.front: Medical negligence comprises four elements : Duty: Duty of the physician is to provide care equal to the same standard of care ordinarily executed by surgeons in the same medical specialty. Breach of duty: Breach of duty occurs when action or failure to act deviates from the standard of care. Causation: Causation is present when it is demonstrated that failure to meet the standard of care was the direct cause of the patient's injuries. Damages: Damages are monies awarded as compensation for injuries sustained as the result of medical negligence.
